limitations: Four packets within a run are not independent replications.
Undelivered through 60 s is right-censored, not permanent failure.
Run 1 invalidates via RERR; runs 2 and 3 invalidate during purge.
The six first-packet timing records are the two retention motifs with INVALID-only, not cold-start or post-deletion runs.
reuse_scope: Pristine official ns-3.47 optimized non-AODV shared libraries only; complete AODV libraries and observer compiled afresh.
tested_build_route: --ns3 with previously clean-built official archive base; --archive bootstrap documented but not repeated for this module
